title: IaC orchestration: single Terraform module to deploy/manage Prometheus, Grafana, OTel collector and log forwarding in customer VPCs
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Create a single, opinionated Terraform module that provisions an observability stack inside customer VPCs: Prometheus (operator/CRD), Grafana (provisioned dashboards + API keys), an OpenTelemetry Collector (Helm chart with modular pipelines), and a resilient log-forwarding component (Vector or a lightweight forwarder) that ships to S3/ES/Redwood Ingest. The module must include lifecycle hooks and automated health checks so upgrades are non-disruptive and customers get clear runbooks and telemetry when an upgrade rolls out.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes clear inputs for network (subnet IDs, security groups), S3/ES endpoints, and optional forwarder destinations
Deploys Prometheus stack with ServiceMonitor CRDs wired to application namespaces and a default scrape config matching Redwood runtime metrics
Grafana is provisioned with at least 3 reusable dashboards and an admin API key output (rotatable)
OTel Collector deployed as Helm release with configurable receivers/processors/exporters and a stable config template; supports hot-reload via configmap versioning
Log-forwarding component reliably ships logs to S3 and exposes per-node backpressure metrics; supports batching and retry
Module implements pre-upgrade validation and post-upgrade health checks; if health-check fails, automatic rollback or canary fallback is triggered per rollout policy input
Terraform plan/apply runs are idempotent and produce deterministic resource names/outputs
Documentation includes upgrade playbook, troubleshooting checklist, and links to dashboards and relevant PRs
tasks: Design module input/output schema and naming conventions
Implement Helm provider resources and values templates for OTel collector
Create Prometheus operator manifests and ServiceMonitor templating
Wire Grafana provisioning via provisioning API and maintain dashboard JSON in module
Implement log-forwarder helm chart wrapper with S3 sink and metrics telemetry
Add null_resource or external healthcheck lambda to run pre/post upgrade checks
Write automated acceptance Terraform integration tests (terragrunt/localstack where appropriate)
Author docs: module README, upgrade playbook, healthcheck runbook
notes: We should avoid embedding customer credentials in state. Use external secrets/KMS. Consider optional sasl/https connectors for ES targets. For on-prem customers provide a flag to switch to syslog or fluentd wrapper rather than S3.
rollout_plan: 1) Merge module changes behind feature flag. 2) Deploy to a single sandbox VPC. 3) Run the pre-upgrade validator and smoke tests. 4) Canary to 3 small customer VPCs with monitoring hooks. 5) Roll forward to remaining customers in waves; allow manual rollback window per wave.
test_plan: Unit tests for templates, a terratest suite that provisions into ephemeral AWS account and validates metrics scraping, Grafana API provisioning, OTel config reload behavior, and that log-forwarder reaches S3. Add chaos test that restarts collector during a scrape to validate resiliency.
migration_steps: 1) Annotate existing Prometheus/Grafana resources in customer VPCs. 2) Import resources into Terraform state where feasible. 3) Run non-destructive plan to reconcile. 4) Enable module-managed resources in canary VPCs. 5) Run health-check post-migration and remove old unmanaged resources once stable.
rollback_plan: Module supports a rollback boolean. Healthchecks run after apply; if failure and rollback=true then module triggers Terraform to restore previous release or invokes provider-native rollback (Helm rollback) and notifies on-call. Manual runbook also provided.
